description: Carte communale de Vieux-Pont is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cnig.gouv.fr. Digitized Communal Card (CC). This lot informs of the right to build on the commune of Vieux-Pont. This municipal card is digitized in accordance with the national requirements of the CNIG. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Municipal map of Vieux-Pont" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include planification, données ouvertes. The listing shows 2014-11-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
